title: Pour un nouveau roman (For a New Novel: Essays on Fiction)

publication.publisher_or_container: Les Éditions de Minuit; English by Grove Press / Northwestern University Press

verification.verification_notes: Publisher record confirms the essay collection and its argument for a neutral registering of sensations and things; the 'chosisme' label was applied by critics (notably Barthes) and was partly rejected by Robbe-Grillet.

limitations: The critical term 'chosisme' (thing-ism) is an interpretation Robbe-Grillet disputed; the record uses his own essay claims, not the label.
